b.x: Dimension, here, is not a place and not a sky. It is a degree of consciousness, as the site already teaches. The sum is an open map, not laboratory physics and not a diploma. This page does not dial.

The knowledge of this site is not all in the same degree. Sixty percent is the third dimension: the fact. Water, fire, house, street, medicine, law, the side of the face. Twenty-five percent is the fourth: the pattern. Seeing the repetition, the intention behind the speech, what the body voted before the sentence. Fifteen percent is the fifth: the choice of tone. The observer participates. Fear is not a home. Zero percent is the sixth or the seventh as an address. The sum is this. Three times sixty hundredths, plus four times twenty-five hundredths, plus five times fifteen hundredths. One point eight, plus one, plus zero point seventy-five. It gives three point fifty-five. On the map, it is read as three point six. Between the third and the fourth. Closer to the fourth. That is the true degree of what is written.

The frequency of the site stays 400. Reason. On the map of dimensions, 400 is the end of the fourth and the door of the fifth. End of the fourth: the person sees the fact and the pattern without handing themselves to the film. Door of the fifth: the person can already choose the tone, instead of being the tone. A door is not a house. Whoever read the sentence of the fifth and moved into it in speech dropped to pride. Pride, on the hertz map, is 175. It is still force. It is still the third. The site does not make that trip for anyone.
The energy in the life of the one who studies

Studying this site does not deliver a degree. It delivers a use. In concrete life, the energy that can arrive is this: less spent on rehearsed fear, more act in the hour that exists. The person comes to have a sentence for the street, a sum for the house, an eye for the stroke, a pace adjusted to the one who walks slowly, and the refusal to live inside the headline. That does not make anyone special. It makes Tuesday less scattered. Less scattered is more alive. That is what 3.6 does when it is practiced. If the study only increases fear, the session fell to 100, and 100 is not the fourth or the fifth. It is contraction. The page can be at 400. The person is the one who chooses whether to climb.
How far study can take a person

Whoever truly studies, and practices on Tuesday, can steady the third: the fact stops being a film surprise. They can learn the fourth: seeing the pattern before the scene, the intention before the compliment, the body before the excuse. They can touch the fifth, once at a time: choose the tone, notice that the thought is not the person, not live in fear. To touch is not to live there. The fifth, on this site, is expansion, not a change of city. The sixth, continuous peace without Tuesday, and the seventh, identity dissolved all the time, are not the fruit of this reading. The site names them so the person does not confuse a pretty sentence with a degree. The honest ceiling of the one who studies is this: competence in the third, reading in the fourth, and the door of the fifth open. No more.
One hundred people. A model, not a census.

There is no measurement of students. Whoever invents a rate of lives saved is lying. What fits is a fair model of one hundred people who truly study, entering at degree three, identified with the story. Forty do not evolve. They stay at three. Some drop, if the text becomes a house of fear. Thirty-five steady the fact and do one act. A gain of three tenths. Degree three point three. Twenty reach a usable fourth: they read the pattern and the intention. A gain of one degree. Degree four. Five touch the fifth once. A gain of one and a half. Degree four point five. They do not stay. The average of the hundred is this. Forty times three, plus thirty-five times three point three, plus twenty times four, plus five times four point five. One hundred twenty, plus one hundred fifteen point five, plus eighty, plus twenty-two point five. Three hundred thirty-eight, divided by one hundred. Three point thirty-eight. They left three. They rose thirty-eight hundredths. It is not a dimension. It is a third of a step. The real expansion is in the twenty. The saved life, if it comes, is in the thirty-five.
What weighs for it and what weighs against

For it. The act fits on a Tuesday: water, medicine, a meeting point, the side of the face, the first no, the pace of the slowest. Fear is described so it does not become a home. The ceiling is said. Nobody is promoted to awakened for having read. One page, at the right hour, can be enough. Against it. The collapse pages, read as a film, drop the person to one hundred hertz. The size of the site can become a collection instead of an act. The language of consciousness can become pride, and pride is one hundred seventy-five, still force. Reading the fifth does not install the fifth. The site does not replace a doctor, in-person training, or the law. And there is no measured class. Any salvation number that is not this model is outside the truth.

It can. It does not guarantee. A life does not stay because of the number three point six or of four hundred. It stays if the act meets the hour. One person recognizes slurred speech and the weak side in the first minute. One does not walk into rising water. One does not give the second yes. One does not stop the medicine on their own. One does not drag the one who walks more slowly. If none of these is done, the answer is no. Reading does not save. If one of them is done in the hour, the answer can be yes. The unit is one life. It is not a promised percentage. Among the hundred in the model, the thirty-five are the path. The twenty expand consciousness. The five touch the door. The forty prove the limit. One life that stays already justifies the text. One hundred invented lives do not.
